summary: Penobscot County, ME: Chick Hill (Peaked Mountain) lookout erected 1947, removed between 1976 and 1993; a rusted base and a fenced communications tower remain at the summit.

facts.status_note: Tower removed between 1976 and 1993 per FFLOS; a rusted base remains where an observation tower stood, beside a fenced communications tower

access.note: No official rules posted; the hike to the top follows a rough gravel road from a gravel parking area. An unofficial orange-blazed trail crosses private property and needs permission (BDN, 2016)

visit.trail_note: About 1.3 miles up a rough gravel road (Fire Road 32 on Google Maps) from a gravel parking area; open granite ledges at the top

events.note: New lookout tower on Chick Hill, erected about a month before a Portland Press Herald item of April 23, 1947
FFLOS gives only a window: removed between 1976 and 1993; 1976 is the earliest year in that window
Registered with the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on September 15, 2008; nominated by Henry Isenberg

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS calls the site Peaked Mountain Tower Site; Forest Lookouts calls it Chick Hill; the BDN write-up says locals call the peak Chick Hill while official maps label it Peaked Mountain. The FFLOS coordinates match the brief record, so these are one site.

notes_for_editor: Only three sources; the 1947 build is from a 1947 newspaper item quoted by Forest Lookouts, not the original. Removal is a window (1976-1993) from FFLOS, with no other source. The rusted base is from a 2016 write-up and is not dated or tied by that write-up to the 1947 tower. Do not merge with the Peaked Mountain in Washington County (44.88795, -67.91016, 'Tower Gone' on the FFLOS Maine list), which is a different site. A Maine lookout database quoted in a search summary (35-foot steel tower, removed in the 1980s, 1,200 ft) could not be opened (firelookout.org/lookouts/me/me.htm returned 404), so it is not used. The FFLOS page does not give a height.
